parameters.name: DateOptions
parameters.description:
The date configurations for clustering.

>  Adjusting these configurations affects existing spatiotemporal clusters for the dataset.

parameters.name: LocationOptions
parameters.description:
The geolocation configurations for clustering.

>  Adjusting these configurations affects existing spatiotemporal clusters for the dataset.

parameters.name: Notification
parameters.description: The notification settings. For information about the asynchronous notification format, see [Asynchronous message examples](~~2743997~~).

parameters.name: Tags
parameters.description: The custom tags. You can search for or filter asynchronous tasks by custom tag.

parameters.name: UserData
parameters.description: The custom information, which is returned in an asynchronous notification and facilitates notification management. The maximum length of the value is 2,048 bytes.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun imm create-location-date-clustering-task --project-name test-project --dataset-name test-dataset --user-data test-data --tags User=Jane --date-options MinDays=1 GapDays=1 MaxDays=15 --location-options '{"LocationDateClusterLevels":["province"]}' --notification example-string --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
